landing.headline: Instant AI Credit Decisioning & Digital Payments
landing.subline: K-Lab is a fintech company dedicated to transforming B2B payment, credit, and financial infrastructure through proprietary AI and blockchain technology.
landing.ourTechnologies: One Ecosystem for the Business of Tomorrow
landing.technologiesSubline: Founded in 2026 as the next evolution of a legacy started in 2020, we bring 6 years of capitalized experience, high-end production, and strategic technology ecosystem access to the table.

technologies.krails: Blockchain infrastructure for automated, real-time B2B payments and settlement.
technologies.kena: Kena is a proprietary system for Intelligent Financial Infrastructure (IFI).
technologies.ktalk: A conversational AI interface that gives instant, natural-language access to operational, financial, and transactional data across all K-Lab systems.
technologies.krisk: An automated risk-decisioning engine that uses AI, data models, and dynamic rules to evaluate credit, detect fraud, and monitor exposures in real time.
technologies.kabl: K-Abl is an AI and blockchain powered financial ecosystem, anchored by K-Rails unifying all K Modules into a single intelligent platform.
technologies.kcard: Corporate card issuance, expense management, and global enforcement. Automating manual processes for more efficient spend management and reporting oversight.
technologies.kbpm: The orchestration engine that powers every operational process across the K-Lab lending ecosystem.
technologies.kim: Turns a traditionally manual, error-prone process into a fully automated, intelligent, and trusted digital workflow—unlocking speed, liquidity, and confidence across the supply chain.
technologies.kaxis: Powerful CRM system built to give you real-time visibility into every aspect of your customer’s financial journey. From credit lines and loans to payments and balances, centralizes key customer data in a single, easy-to-use platform.
technologies.kleads: Surface more qualified leads to maximize commercial efficiency leading to accelerated growth and deal flow.
technologies.kai: Sitting at the core of our suite of modules. Kai supports full lifecycle orchestration from onboarding, origination to loan management and settlement.
